title: One wedge is silent
intro: Start where the problem is. Click the silent wedge and look at its lights and its input. Is signal arriving? Is it switched on?

complaints.says: My wedge is completely dead. Everyone else can hear theirs.

cause: Wedge 3's power switch was off. Signal was arriving at its input the whole time.
lesson: When one speaker is dead and the rest work, check that speaker first: power, the power cord, and its volume knob. If its input shows signal, the mixer is fine.
